name: dsh-plugin-tailor
purpose: Tailor a repository to fit: audit it across 8 dimensions / 44 checks, pick or author a structured README style with three layout engines, draft a bilingual README, generate a deterministic 12-file brand kit with WCAG contrast QA, and verify links before publishing.

tools.name: repo_styles
tools.description: List the structured README style presets repo_readme can render: 7 built-ins plus custom JSON styles from <repo>/.tailor/styles and ~/.tailor/styles. Shows where each style was loaded from and any invalid style files. Pass json:true for a machine-readable payload. Read-only.

tools.name: repo_audit
tools.description: Audit a repository across 8 maturity dimensions / 44 checks (identity, first screen, install, docs, evidence, release, community, brand & visual). Returns a 0-100 score, per-dimension breakdown and a prioritized gap list. Read-only.

tools.name: repo_plan
tools.description: Turn the audit gaps into an ordered task list (P0/P1/P2) with explicit acceptance criteria, style-specific prep tasks and the verify command for each task. Read-only.

tools.name: repo_readme
tools.description: Draft a README for the chosen style from repository facts, or apply it. Dry-run by default and prints the diff; apply refuses to overwrite hand-written READMEs or a dirty worktree unless force=true. Missing facts become visible TODO markers, never invented claims.

tools.name: repo_brand
tools.description: Generate a real brand kit from 12 hand-built vector concepts: icon, maskable icon, light/dark logo lockups, light/dark wordmarks, light/dark 1280×400 banners, a 1280×640 social card, a concept contact sheet, brand-tokens.json (palette + WCAG contrast + type/spacing/motion tokens) and assets/README.m

tools.name: repo_brief
tools.description: Draft or update the shared repository brief: promise, audience, voice, visual direction, non-goals and acceptance. Facts seed the draft; audience, voice and non-goals are left as open questions until a human answers. Writes .tailor/brief.json and .tailor/BRIEF.md on apply, and keeps human edits unle

tools.name: repo_agent
tools.description: Generate the agent layer for a repository: agent.json (contract scaffold inferred from package.json and host/register.js), llms.txt (agent index) and a styled docs site from docs/*.md. Semantic gaps stay as explicit open items. Dry-run by default; apply writes files and keeps hand-written ones unles

tools.name: repo_verify
tools.description: Re-run the audit plus link, anchor, image, badge and required-section checks. Reports PASS/FAIL, leftover TODO markers and the score delta against the baseline saved by repo_readme --apply. Read-only.

openItems: Tools: review the inferred names and descriptions; add inputs, outputs and read/write to agent.json.
Validation: replace validation.expected with the real expected result.
Brief: no .tailor/brief.json; run repo_brief before generating the agent layer.
